host_sched.help.list: The scheduled checks with their numbers, the next check and the price
host_sched.help.cost: The price of the schedule: traffic and CPU a day and a month
host_sched.help.add: Add a check to the schedule
host_sched.help.rm: Remove a check from the schedule
host_sched.help.on: Turn a check of the schedule on
host_sched.help.off: Turn a check off (it stays in the list)
host_sched.help.time: The time HH:MM in the time zone of the server
host_sched.help.days: Days of the week 1–7 (1 is Monday), e.g. 1-5, 1,3,7 or all
host_sched.help.no_quiet: Check even when the server is busy (by default only when it is free)
host_sched.help.monthly: Monthly: in the first week of the month, on one chosen day
host_sched.help.entry: The number in the list or the id of the entry
host_sched.help.dry: Show the change and the price, save nothing
host_sched.help.yes: Agree to «much traffic» without a question
host_sched.help.code: The code of --dry: save only the change that was shown
host_sched.help.history: The history of the server checks
host_sched.help.hdays: The last N days (instead of --from and --to)
host_sched.help.by: Who started it: schedule, panel, bot, cli, mcp, ssh, auto
host_sched.help.limit: At most N rows (200 by default)
host_sched.help.id: The id of a check of the history
host_sched.help.export: Export the history as CSV or JSON (no addresses or keys)
host_sched.help.out: Write to a new file (else to the screen)
host_sched.title: The schedule of the checks (time zone {tz})
host_sched.tz_warn: The time zone of the server is not read: the times are in UTC+03:00.
host_sched.off_why.per_day: more checks a day than allowed
host_sched.off_why.full_per_day: more full checks a day than allowed
host_sched.off_why.gap: less than 2 h to the next check
host_sched.off_why.other: turned off by the check of the list
host_sched.cost: Price: {day} a day, {month} a month, ≈ {cpu} min of CPU a day
host_sched.armed_why.no_manual: The scheduled checks start after the first manual check.
host_sched.armed_why.no_pkgs: The scheduled checks will not start: sysbench and fio are missing. They can be installed at a manual check.
host_sched.armed_why.other_machine: The schedule came from another server: check this server manually once.
host_sched.armed_why.no_machine_id: No /etc/machine-id — the scheduled checks will not start.
host_sched.retry_on: If a link drops sharply, check again in 1–2 h: on.
host_sched.retry_off: If a link drops sharply, check again in 1–2 h: off.
host_sched.timer_stale: The timer of the schedule is not updated: kaskadctl host bench schedule apply.
host_sched.timer_stale_screen: The timer of the schedule is not updated — choose «5) Update the timer» below.
host_sched.heavy_screen: The schedule will use much traffic — save only if you agree.
host_sched.not_applied_root: The schedule is saved; only root sets the timer.
host_sched.heavy_dry: Much traffic: it saves only with consent (--yes or the question in a terminal).
host_sched.ask_heavy: The schedule uses much traffic. Save it?
host_sched.err.days: Days are numbers 1–7 (1 is Monday): e.g. 1-5, 1,3,7 or all.
host_sched.err.mode: The check is quick or full.
host_sched.err.no_entry: No entry «{ref}» — a number of the list or an id.
host_sched.err.code: The code does not match: the schedule or the change is different now. Look at the change again.
host_sched.err.heavy_mcp: Much traffic: only a person saves such a schedule — in the SSH menu 22 → 4 or in the server’s terminal: {cmd}.
host_sched.err.need_yes: Much traffic: add --yes if you agree.
host_sched.err.by: Who started it — schedule, panel, bot, cli, mcp, ssh or auto.
host_sched.err.format: The format is csv or json.
host_sched.err.exists: The file exists — give a new name.
host_sched.mode_differs: The checks are of different kinds: the comparison is rough.
host_sched.history_none_skipped: No skipped checks in this time.
host_sched.more: Not all are shown: shorten the period (--from, --to) or raise --limit.
host_sched.err.tz_changed: The time zone of the server has changed — open the schedule again.
host_sched.err.stale: The schedule was changed elsewhere meanwhile — open it again and repeat.
host_sched.err.need_confirm: The schedule uses a lot of traffic — confirm the save.
host_sched.err.span: The period is at most {max} days, the end not before the start.
